items.summary_zh: 胡志明市今年34,161例登革熱,第38週新增1,462例,高於去年同期。
items.summary_en: Ho Chi Minh City has reported 34,161 dengue cases this year as of week 38, with 1,462 in week 38 alone, higher than the same period last year.

items.summary_zh: 孟加拉今年累計住院9萬9,275例、303例死亡;古巴病例為預期9.2倍
items.summary_en: Bangladesh has reported 99,275 cumulative hospitalized dengue cases and 303 deaths this year, and Cuba's cases are 9.2 times expected levels.

items.disease_zh: 登革熱,屈公病,瘧疾,黃熱病,茲卡病毒感染症,麻疹,白喉,百日咳
items.disease_en: Dengue fever, Chikungunya, Malaria, Yellow fever, Zika virus infection, Measles, Diphtheria, Pertussis (whooping cough)
items.headline_zh: 委內瑞拉-麻疹等震災後傳染病
items.headline_en: Venezuela – Communicable disease risks after earthquake
items.summary_zh: 委內瑞拉6/24大地震後,WHO警告麻疹、登革熱等傳染病風險上升
items.summary_en: After a 24 June earthquake in Venezuela, WHO warned of rising risks for measles, dengue, yellow fever, malaria and other communicable diseases amid low vaccination coverage.

items.summary_zh: 廣東省今年4–8月屈公病736例,8月496例,逐月上升,但遠低於去年同期。
items.summary_en: Guangdong, China reported 736 chikungunya cases from April to August this year, rising monthly but well below last year's levels.

items.summary_zh: 奈及利亞今年逾2.6萬例疑似病例、700例死亡;美國紐約州出現旅遊相關病例
items.summary_en: Nigeria reported over 26,000 suspected diphtheria cases and 700 deaths this year; New York's Erie County reported a travel-related case.

items.summary_zh: 歐洲第38週新冠陽性率升至15%,南非流感陽性率9%,以B型為主。
items.summary_en: Europe's COVID-19 positivity rose to 15% in week 38, while South Africa's influenza positivity was 9%, mainly influenza B in recent weeks.
